/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, re, os
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/Users/bench/Sorty-Benchmark/v1/perception/runs/B1-C0-02/workspace').resolve()
base = root.parent
inventory = json.loads((base / 'inventory.json').read_text())
preview = Path('/private/tmp/B1-C0-02-preview.md').read_text()
ops = {}
for line in preview.splitlines():
    if not line.startswith('| D'):
        continue
    cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip('|').split('|')]
    doc_id = cells[0]
    src = cells[1].strip('"'`'"')
    action = cells[2]
    target_cell = cells[3]
    target_match = re.search(r'"'`([''^`]+)`'"', target_cell)
    target = target_match.group(1) if target_match else None
    ops[doc_id] = (src, action, target)
assert len(ops) == 29, f'preview contains {len(ops)} rows, expected 29'
expected = {row['id']: row for row in inventory}
assert set(ops) == set(expected), 'preview IDs differ from inventory'
# Validate every source/hash and all target conditions before changing anything.
for doc_id, row in expected.items():
    src, action, target = ops[doc_id]
    source_path = (root / src).resolve()
    assert source_path.is_relative_to(root) and source_path.is_file(), f'missing/outside source {doc_id}: {src}'
    digest = hashlib.sha256(source_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert digest == row['sha256'], f'source hash mismatch for {doc_id}'
    if action == '移动、重命名':
        assert target, f'missing destination {doc_id}'
        dest_path = (root / target).resolve()
        assert dest_path.is_relative_to(root), f'destination outside workspace {doc_id}'
        assert not dest_path.exists(), f'destination already exists: {target}'
    else:
        assert action == '保持原位，待确认' and target is None, f'unexpected action for {doc_id}: {action}'
# Apply precisely the approved move/rename operations.
for doc_id in sorted(ops):
    src, action, target = ops[doc_id]
    if action "'!= '"'移动、重命名':
        continue
    source_path = root / src
    dest_path = root / target
    dest_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.rename(source_path, dest_path)
# Verify all 29 document hashes at the approved final paths and total file count.
files = [p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
assert len(files) == 29, f'workspace has {len(files)} files, expected 29'
for doc_id, row in expected.items():
    src, action, target = ops[doc_id]
    final_path = root / (target if action == '移动、重命名' else src)
    assert final_path.is_file(), f'missing final file {doc_id}: {final_path}'
    digest = hashlib.sha256(final_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert digest == row['sha256'], f'final hash mismatch for {doc_id}'
# No planning/report/index artifacts were written in workspace; file set is exactly the 29 inventory entries.
expected_paths = {
    (ops[doc_id][2] if ops[doc_id][1] == '移动、重命名' else ops[doc_id][0])
    for doc_id in ops
}
actual_paths = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in files}
assert actual_paths == expected_paths, 'workspace file paths differ from preview plan'
print(f'Applied {sum(1 for _, action, _ in ops.values() if action == \"移动、重命名\")} moves/renames.')
print(f'Kept {sum(1 for _, action, _ in ops.values() if action "'!= "移动、重命名")} files in place.'"')
print(f'Integrity verified: {len(files)}/{len(expected)} files; every SHA-256 matches inventory.')
print('No extra files found in workspace; file paths match the approved preview exactly.')
PY"
